system.description: As an action, spend 3 mana to summon a spectral monster into an unoccupied space within 30 feet. It has hit points equal to twice your class level and can make one Slash or Cast attack dealing 1d8 + your Intelligence modifier on each of your turns. You can have only one monster summoned at a time, and it vanishes if reduced to 0 hit points or if you dismiss it.
